params.name: Boundary toad fourth deletion: test period-two recurrence

decisions.reason: Explorer: Test the next deletion contrast in the toad family, building on the measured three-cell seed from life-0016. Experimentalist: The base toad occupies [15,14], [0,14], [1,14], [14,15], [15,15], [0,15]. These toggles leave [15,14] and [0,15], an explicit two-cell diagonal across the toroidal boundary. Submit the falsifiable claim of period-2 recurrence over 48 generations; no recurrence is inferred from geometry alone. Replication skeptic: The one-cell deletion became extinct, paired deletion became fixed, and three-cell deletion recovered a fixed block, so nearby results do not determine this seed’s behavior. Let the engine measure generations and translated reproduction.
alternatives: Rejected repeating the three-deletion seed: life-0016 already measured fixed period 1 after one transient generation.
Rejected claiming a fixed block: the remaining cells are diagonal, not the measured square configuration.
Deferred an unrelated template: this controlled deletion tests the latest toad-family result.
